title: A Bad Report
text: … and he brought their father a bad report about them.

title: A Robe of Many Colors
text: … so he made him a robe of many colors.

title: Not a Kind Word
text: … they hated him and could not speak a kind word to him.

title: The Dream of the Sheaves
text: … my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around and bowed down to mine.

title: Sun, Moon and Stars
text: … the sun and moon and eleven stars were bowing down to me.

title: Kept in Mind
text: And his brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept in mind what he had said.

title: The Firstborn
text: The sons of Leah were Reuben the firstborn of Jacob …

title: Benjamin
text: But his father called him Benjamin.

title: Bilhah's Sons
text: The sons of Rachel’s maidservant Bilhah were Dan and Naphtali.

title: A New Name
text: Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel …
